# Customer Actions for Jira

> Customer Actions for Jira extends the Jira Service Management customer portal with configurable actions: customers can edit their requests, select and link related issues, and read and acknowledge documents. Published by Realigned Technologies.

## Product

- [Customer Actions for Jira](https://customeractions.app/): interactive actions for the Jira Service Management portal.
- [Atlassian Marketplace listing](https://marketplace.atlassian.com/1229532)
